note: Fresh Open-Meteo current retrieval for a genuine daylight generation. Not a copy of the night-card weather file. Times are Europe/Amsterdam so the scenario hour matches the retrieval hour. is_day is the sun at the site coordinates. Local civil time for these Caribbean sites is America/Kralendijk (UTC-4).
local_timezone_note: Site local zone is America/Kralendijk. Retrieval clock and scenario use Europe/Amsterdam, per the pack rule that the scenario is the Amsterdam generation time.
scenario_basis: Scenario minute is the Europe/Amsterdam mtime of the text-prompt 16:9 generation. Weather fields are only the Open-Meteo current retrieval at retrieval_timestamp. Not a fixed label and not copied from the night card.
